title: Classic Chicken Tagine
description: A traditional Moroccan dish made with chicken, spices, and dried fruits, slow-cooked in a flavorful tagine.

ingredients.name: quick
ingredients.amount: 1 cup mixed dried fruits (apricots, prunes, raisins)

instructions: Heat the oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cumin, smoked paprika, and dried fruits. Stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Cover the tagine and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 30-40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
